newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi Sec to brief media on earnings revision.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi Sec to brief media on earnings revision.

text.p: Yamaichi Securities Co said on Tuesday it would hold a news conference at 3.40 p.m. (0640 GMT) to announce a revision in its earnings forecast.
Yamaichi said in December that it would post a parent net loss of 110 billion yen in 1996/97 as a result of a payment of 150 billion yen in financial support to its Yamaichi Finance unit.
Yamaichi said at the time that it expected extraordinary profits of about 24 billion yen in 1996/97, partly through the sale of shareholdings.
